title: Follow Ups Legacy Route Permission Consistency

items.action: open the legacy follow-ups alias that redirects to the Todos follow-up view

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.todos.read permission is reused.

backend.reason: Backend todo authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; only the legacy frontend route guard is aligned with its canonical redirect target.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: Navigation redirects do not create auditable business mutations.

menu.reason: The follow-ups alias is not a separate main-navigation item.

forms.reason: No todo or follow-up form behavior changes.

notes: App redirects legacy /follow-ups URLs to /todos?view=follow_ups. The legacy alias now uses the same fair_crm.todos.read boundary as the canonical Todos surface, avoiding a transient permission-denied state for legitimate Todo readers. Redirect behavior and backend authorization are unchanged.
